identity.name: The Club at Ibis
identity.notes: A small, upscale gated community in the Ibis area of West Palm Beach, situated near the Intracoastal Waterway and Ibis Park. It is a low-density, single-family enclave known for its quiet, waterfront-adjacent setting.

fees.note: Exact amount unknown; comparable gated communities in West Palm Beach typically charge approximately $300-$700/month. No specific CDD assessment identified for this community in available knowledge.

NOT community-specific: this is the average monthly HOA fee for West Palm Beach citywide per hoa-agent.com. The Club at Ibis fee itself is listed as 'not yet verified by residents' — no verified community HOA amount found. Community is managed by FirstService Residential; utilities via FPL (electric) and City of West Palm Beach (water/sewer/trash). No CDD assessment info found. An official club membership fee schedule (Nov 2024–Oct 2025) exists at u.realgeeks.media/pbcoastal/Ibis_2025_membership_fees_.pdf but the PDF could not be parsed (binary). Club membership is separate from HOA dues and is mandatory per hoabulletinboard.com (unverified). Confidence low because the amount is a citywide average, not the community's fee. Verify directly with the association/club before purchase. (Retrieved 2026-10-11T00:00:00Z, confidence 0.3.)
